title: Training Under Challenge: Executable Certificates and Challenge-Closed Optimality for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.12655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A flat training curve does not reveal whether a neural network has reached a global optimum, is locally trapped, is representation-limited, or is mismatched to its trainer. We introduce Training Under Challenge, an executable-certificate framework in which predeclared, architecture-valid procedures construct complete alternatives in the same certified class and reevaluate the same objective. Any lower-valued candidate is a replayable witness that lower-bounds the checkpoint's empirical global-optimality gap. Passing a finite suite is only suite-relative; global-gap conclusions require a separately justified coverage mechanism. We define a resource-indexed challenge-power modulus that characterizes the largest gap compatible with passage. For squared loss, current block-decrease operators make coverage checkable and yield uniform and realized-residual bounds. translated_title: 挑战下的训练：神经网络的可执行证书与挑战封闭最优性
translated_abstract: 平坦的训练曲线并不能揭示神经网络是否已达到全局最优、是否陷入局部困境、是否受限于表示能力，或是否与其训练器不匹配。我们引入了“挑战下的训练”这一可执行证书框架，其中预先声明且架构验证的程序在同一认证类别中构建完整替代方案，并重新评估相同目标。任何较低值的候选者都是一个可重放的见证，它限定了检查点经验全局最优性差距的下界。通过有限测试集仅与测试集相关；全局差距结论需要单独证明的覆盖机制。我们定义了一个资源索引的挑战能力模量，它刻画了与通过测试兼容的最大差距。对于平方损失，当前的块递减算子使覆盖可检查，并产生一致性和实现残差界限。我们证明了逆边界：在没有覆盖的情况下，一阶ReLU训练器可以...
tldr: 本文提出“挑战下训练”框架，通过可执行证书和覆盖机制量化神经网络的全局最优性差距，并证明无覆盖时一阶ReLU训练器的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "Training Under Challenge" framework with executable certificates and coverage mechanisms to quantify global optimality gaps in neural networks, and proves limitations of first-order ReLU trainers without coverage.
